description: This PHP class 'exec_cfield_mgr' manages custom fields for test execution in the TestLink project, including generating HTML inputs, retrieving linked custom fields, and processing user-set filter values.

classes.name: exec_cfield_mgr
classes.description: A class for managing custom fields related to test execution, extending cfield_mgr.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing database reference and linked custom fields.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_inputs
methods.description: Generates HTML table rows for custom field input elements.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields
methods.description: Retrieves linked custom fields for a specific project, filtering out text areas, date, and datetime types.

methods.name: field_names
methods.description: Returns an array of custom field identifiers and metadata.

methods.name: get_set_values
methods.description: Retrieves user-set filter values for custom fields from request parameters.
